title: Speed: two increments, one expression
prompt:
SPEED DRILL — target under 90 seconds.

What is the value of `y`?

```java
int x = 5;
int y = x++ + ++x;
```

A. 10
B. 11
C. 12
D. 13

Call `answer(...)` exactly once with your option letter and a one-sentence reason.

tests.name: C speed
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.answer("C. check"));
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("C"), "answer must start with the correct option letter");
tests.hint: C. x++ yields 5 then x becomes 6; ++x makes 7 and yields 7; 5 + 7 = 12. B forgets one increment; D applies both increments before reading.
